en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a formal garden square with a large white pedestal bearing a seated statue of a man (Nubar Pasha) in the center. A lamppost stands nearby, and landscaped flowerbeds and trees surround the monument. In the background a tall column can be seen. There is printed red text in French at the top identifying the view, a circular postal mark on the left, and handwriting in ink on the lower right.
